q: Which Regulation E duties have nothing behind them?
answer: One: provisional credit within 5 business days for card and ACH errors (D-1005-E2). The policy still says 10 business days and the procedure says day 7, so neither meets the new limit.

q: What is due before the exam?
answer: Four areas are not yet proven: Regulation E error resolution, flood insurance, information security and vendor management. The Reg E and MFA changes are the two with deadlines before 8 February.
